idea-plugin.name: GitHub Multi-Account
idea-plugin.description:
Work with several GitHub accounts without committing or pushing as the wrong person. Pick an account in the status bar and the current repository is switched to it in one click.

What switching does

Everything is written to the repository's local git config, so other projects are not affected:
  • user.name / user.email — commits are authored by the selected account
  • HTTPS remotes become https://<login>@github.com/… — pushes authenticate as that account
  • core.sshCommand with the account's key, if one is set — SSH pushes use that key
  • the matching IDE GitHub account becomes the project's default (pull requests, share, gists)

Features

  • Status bar widget showing the current commit identity; click to switch (also Git | Switch GitHub Account…, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+G)
  • Warning when a repository has no account selected and falls back to the global git identity
  • Import accounts from Settings | Version Control | GitHub, or log in to a new one — its repositories then appear in Git | Clone
  • Optional: also update the global git identity on switch
  • Interface in English, O'zbekcha and Русский

Privacy

The plugin stores only the account list you enter (name, email, GitHub login, SSH key path) in the IDE settings. When you import accounts, it uses the token already saved by the IDE's GitHub integration to call api.github.com/user and /user/emails once, only to read the name and email. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

action.description: Switch the GitHub account for the current repository
